        (select json_build_object('name', name, 'protobase_version', protobase_version, 'model', model) from migrations.history order by applied_at desc limit 1) as newest,
        (select at is not null from matched) as matched,
        (select coalesce(json_agg(h.name order by h.applied_at), '[]') from migrations.history h, matched where h.applied_at > matched.at and h.additive is not true) as not_additive,
        (select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('name', h.name, 'after', h.physical -> 'after') order by h.applied_at), '[]') from migrations.history h where h.completed_at is null) as unfinished

-- protobase:record modules
-- The row that records this migration as applied, which the server reads at startup.
create schema if not exists migrations;
create table if not exists migrations.history (
  id text primary key,
  number integer,
  name text not null,
  protobase_version text not null,
  model jsonb not null,
  model_hash text not null,
  physical jsonb not null,
  additive boolean,
  sql_hash text,
  applied_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),
  completed_at timestamptz
);
create index if not exists history_applied_at on migrations.history (applied_at);
